children: lifted the lower end of its 2026 revenue forecast after quarterly earnings exceeded expectations, while customer interest in equipment deliveries for 2029 and 2030 pointed to sustained demand for advanced chipmaking technology.

The Dutch equipment maker reported third-quarter net profit of 4.96 billion euros, above analysts' estimate of 4.1 billion euros. Net sales reached 11.66 billion euros, slightly below the 11.72 billion euros expected by LSEG. Gross margin came in at 57.5%, ahead of the company's guidance.

ASML now expects 2026 revenue of 44 billion to 45 billion euros, raising its previous floor of 43 billion euros. For the fourth quarter, it projected sales of 14.2 billion to 15.2 billion euros and a gross margin near 57%.

Demand visibility is also prompting the company to examine whether it can expand production capacity for 2028 beyond its previously communicated 30% increase. ASML makes extreme ultraviolet lithography systems, used to manufacture advanced chips.

Export restrictions remain a risk, particularly in China, which ASML expects to account for about 20% of its business. Future performance will depend partly on converting longer-term customer interest into confirmed orders.

title: ASML Just Delivered Beat-and-Raise Third Quarter
